AppShield scans the apps installed on your device and calculates a risk score based on the sensitive permissions each app requests. It helps you understand which apps have access to personal data like your camera, microphone, contacts, location, and SMS.

AppShield is not an antivirus or malware detector. The risk score is a project-defined heuristic, not an official Android security score. A permission request does not mean an app is malicious. AppShield cannot tell how permissions are actually used by an app.
